name: How long does it take to install a new toilet?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical toilet installation for a standard replacement can often be completed within 1 to 3 hours, assuming no significant issues arise. However, the total time can increase if there are complications such as a damaged toilet flange, corroded water supply lines, or if the new toilet requires changes to the drain rough-in. Preparing by having your new toilet on-site and clear access to the bathroom will help streamline the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard toilet installation usually takes 1 to 3 hours, but can take longer if plumbing repairs or modifications are needed.
